note: Help-centre announcement: voice AI agents generally available to eligible customers after an early access programme; they answer calls end to end on Zendesk voice lines.
Help article: AI agents are created per channel type; messaging (Zendesk web and mobile messaging) is one of the channel types.
Help article lists email (including API and web form) as an AI agent channel type, with its own setup flow.
Help article explains adding the AI agent to WhatsApp or other connected social messaging channels (others not named on that page).
Help article on Zendesk Talk numbers available to purchase (some countries via Support). Voice AI agents are assigned to Zendesk voice lines per the GA announcement.

Help article: SIP-IN lines are used for call forwarding, bring your own carrier and partner apps; SIP-IN is described for third-party AI agents. Native voice AI agents not available with Talk Partner Edition.
Italian is in the AI agents language list; the voice multi-language configuration article lists it-IT as a voice locale.
AI agents language list includes 22 of the 24 EU official languages (Irish and Maltese not listed).
Custom actions call an API the admin specifies; action flows handle multi-step work across Zendesk and external systems; legacy API integrations still work.

Announcement of GA MCP client: admins connect third-party or private MCP servers; tools usable in action flows by AI agents. A Zendesk MCP server is described on Relate 2026 marketing pages; shipping status not confirmed.
Conversation simulator (early access, messaging AI agents) runs multi-turn conversations from customer profiles and scenarios with mock values.
Automated testing for messaging agents shows passed and failed scenarios that can be re-run after editing articles or procedures; simulator scenarios are versioned and re-runnable with run history.
Each automated test scenario is run several times; the scenario passes if the majority of runs pass (majority over trials, not a pass^k metric). Messaging agents only.
Zendesk QA prompt-based categories use AI to score conversations against natural-language criteria; filters can include AI agent conversations. How automated test runs are judged is not stated.
AutoQA accuracy measures agreement between AI ratings and human reviewer ratings per category; the article says AutoQA does not learn directly from that feedback (monitoring, not tuning).
Conversation logs show transcripts (and call recordings for voice), resources used, procedure plan, actions and API requests; points to Zendesk QA for quality scoring.
Before escalating a call the voice AI agent posts transcript and summary to the ticket and updates ticket fields used for routing; agents see summary and detected intent.

No page found on detecting AI or synthetic-voice callers or on a declared-agent protocol. Queries: 'Zendesk AI agent detect AI agents personal agents calling bots agent-to-agent customers'; 'Zendesk voice synthetic voice detection AI caller deepfake'.
Data Center Location add-on lets customers choose a hosting region including the EEA; regional hosting policy notes product-specific exceptions (e.g. some AI agents accounts).
Trust centre states Zendesk is ISO 27001:2022 certified (also ISO 27017, 27018, 27701, 42001 listed).
Trust centre states SOC 2 Type II reports are kept current, available under NDA.

AI Trust article says Zendesk reviewed the EU AI Act, views its customer-interaction features as generally not high-risk, and says chatbot transparency duties are met via AI labelling. Vendor's own position.

Pricing page: AI agents billed by automated resolutions (allowance per agent seat plus packs or pay-as-you-go); base plans per agent seat. Voice AI agents add a per-minute charge per the GA article. Prices not reproduced.
Professional Services terms cover Zendesk-performed configuration and integration under SOWs; pricing page offers a self-serve 14-day trial.
